blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The Cebu Institute of Technology-University (CIT-U) Junior Wildcats continued their winning surge, extending their streak to four games with a convincing 77-51 victory over the Cebu Eastern College (CEC) Dragons in the Cebu Schools Athletic Foundation, Inc. (Cesafi) Season 26 high school basketball tournament on Sunday, November 22, at the Cebu Coliseum. The Junior Wildcats are aiming to finish the elimination round as the second seed to secure a twice-to-beat advantage in the Final Four, with their latest victory keeping their hopes alive.
